b:
I gave my friend a gift that saved me.
A tall, blonde poet who was always wounded herself
In love with a guy
Slipped the sound of Koko Taylor
W-o-m-a-n
Over her ears
Jumped on her bike
And rode home in the wise night.
At last
In love with herself.
I can hold back the lightning
In the palm of my hand.
Shake hands with the devil
Make him crawl in the sand.
She was fierce after Koko taught her
What growled out of her gorgeously
Comes first
And lists her all the way
To the moon.
Did you hear me?
I’m telling myself now.
